why_split: the file is 530441 bytes and paste.rs cannot serve it. It ACCEPTS up to 81919 bytes (200) and refuses 81920 (500) — which is what I measured yesterday and wrongly recorded as 'the limit'. Measured today: an 81919-byte paste is ACCEPTED and then SERVED as only 32329 bytes, deterministically, with Content-Length still declaring 81919. 80000 bytes round-trips intact. So the accept limit and the serve limit are different numbers, and only a readback distinguishes them.
reassemble: concatenate the parts in the listed order, byte for byte, then sha256 the result and compare with whole.sha256. No separators, no trailing newline is added.
second_host: https://paste.c-net.org/LiteralMotels serves the WHOLE file; these parts are the second, independent path. Before today the file had exactly one live address.
